title: ALMA detection of hydrogen cyanide in the atmosphere of Saturn
question: Detect HCN rotational emission in Saturn's atmosphere with ALMA, and derive its abundance, vertical distribution and likely formation mechanism

data.angular_resolution: 0.70, 0.78, 0.82 and 0.85 arcsec for the four frequency ranges respectively

recipe.method: Import the raw ASDM into CASA 5.4.1, set the flux scale with SETJY, flag bad antennas with pipeline tasks, flag telluric channels during bandpass calibration, then apply flux, bandpass and gain calibration
key_parameters: Flux model: Perley-Butler 2017, matched to the calibrator continuum flux to 5% accuracy
Strong telluric ozone line at 355.01 GHz removed

recipe.goal: Make continuum image and line cubes
recipe.method: Split target with MSTRANSFORM; TCLEAN (Hogbom) continuum image from line-free channels; UVCONTSUB; TCLEAN specmode=cube per rest frequency; IMPBCOR primary-beam correction
key_parameters: Continuum image: tclean with hogbom deconvolver using line-free channels
assumptions: Disk flux filtered out by lack of short spacings; only limb emission preserved

recipe.goal: Measure the disk continuum flux density
recipe.method: Disk-average flux density (excluding rings) from a 16 arcsec circle over the planet disk; ring flux not estimated

recipe.goal: Extract limb spectra and measure HCN line shifts
recipe.method: Extract HCN J=4-3 spectra from 2.7 arcsec diameter circular regions on the eastern and western limbs of the cubes and read off the peak velocity shift from the theoretical line centre
key_parameters: Eastern limb aperture centred at RA 18h35m51.873s, Dec -22d19m27.982s (J2000); western limb at RA 18h33m53.128s, Dec -22d19m29.406s
Zero velocity is the theoretical HCN peak at 354.505 GHz
assumptions: Line shifts attributed to strong stratospheric winds between the east and west limbs

recipe.goal: Fit HCN abundance with PSG forward model
recipe.method: Fit PSG model spectra (line-by-line and correlated-k) to the observed limb spectra, with the line velocity fixed per limb, to derive the HCN vertical mixing ratio
key_parameters: Pressure levels of the vertical structure 10 to 100 (ubar as printed), 60 atmospheric layers
Velocity fixed at 8.36 km/s (west) and -9.26 km/s (east)
assumptions: Disk-averaged temperature profile from Lellouch et al. 1984; layers from Moses 2005; HITRAN line parameters

recipe.goal: Retrieve vertical HCN and temperature profiles
recipe.method: Optimal-estimation retrieval with PSG over 10 bar to 100 ubar, 60 layers, using the fitted limb abundances as input; default PSG profiles for other species
key_parameters: Temperature profile from Lellouch et al. 1984; spectroscopy from HITRAN; 60 layers
assumptions: Default PSG vertical profiles for CH4, C2H6, C2H2, NH3 and NH4SH

recipe.goal: Map the spatial distribution of HCN
recipe.method: Integrate the line cubes with IMMOMENTS over the velocity range where HCN is detected and overplot on the continuum map

recipe.goal: Compare abundance with Jupiter and infer formation pathway
recipe.method: Compare the derived Saturn HCN mixing ratio range with Jupiter's value from Tokunaga et al. 1981 and with the laboratory result of Raulin et al. 1979
assumptions: Saturn has a much lower NH3 abundance than Jupiter, so a lower HCN abundance supports photolysis of CH4 and NH3
